checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Only person is the blonde woman

must.why: Same bob, similar face and smile; slight idealisation, but a good likeness.
No trace of the man in the final image.

must.item: Beach/casual replaced with professional clothing and unobtrusive backdrop
must.why: Navy blazer; blurred urban backdrop. The backdrop is somewhat busy but out of focus.

must.item: Square head-and-shoulders portrait, natural lighting, no artifacts
must.why: The image is portrait 4:5, not square. The crop includes torso and a hand at the bottom edge, so it is more than head and shoulders. Crossed arms are slightly awkward.

faults.what: Output is a 4:5 portrait, not square, and extends to the waist rather than head-and-shoulders.
Hand at bottom-left corner is cropped and slightly awkward.
Outdoor city backdrop is not a plain studio background, though it is blurred.
Face is slightly polished and may differ subtly from the source.

summary: A good, realistic professional portrait of the blonde woman in a navy blazer with a blurred city backdrop and no sign of the man; it is not square and shows more than head and shoulders.
